LESSON: SCULPTURE (TOY ASSEMBLAGE)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Performing and Display
Topic 2.3: Sculpture (Toy Assemblage)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sculpture (Toy Assemblage), part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can one join different materials to make a toy?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise toys made by assemblage,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sculpture (Toy Assemblage) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication and collaboration: as the learner works together collect and sort different recyclable material assemblage

of toys or dolls.

 Creativity and imagination: as the learner assemble the materials to get the structure of the doll or toy,

Values:
 Respect: is promoted as the learner gives positive feedback as they display items made.

 Unity: is promoted as the as the learner in groups, collect and sort different recyclable materials

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
 Safety and security: is nurtured as the learner observes their safety collect and sort different recyclable material

assemblage of toys or dolls

 Social cohesion: is promoted as the learner enjoys playing with peers using the toys or dolls created.

Link to other learning areas:

Environmental Activities: as the learner applies knowledge and skills gained in Environmental Activities as assemble the

materials to get the structure of the doll/toy.

Suggested learning resources:

Digital devices, reference books, relevant virtual sites, recyclable material assemblage of toys or dolls, assistive technology such

as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, page-turners, adapted digital devices with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head

control input devices such as head wand
